etsy.title: Elastic Waist Skirt Sewing Pattern PDF, Easy Gathered Skirt XS-3X, Beginner Sewing Project, No Zip Skirt, A4 Letter A0
etsy.description:
The easiest skirt to sew: two rectangles, an elastic casing and a hem. No zip, no darts, perfect as a first sewing project. Nested sizes XS to 3X.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• Front and back panel (cut on fold) with casing fold line
• Nested sizes XS–3X, chosen by hip; elastic length listed for every size
• A4 and US Letter print-at-home files with a test square, plus an A0 copy shop file
• Step-by-step sewing guide with ideas (pockets, tie belt, ruffle, kids' version)
• Everything in English AND German (Deutsch): two downloads

GOOD TO KNOW
• No seam allowance included: add 1.5 cm (5/8 in), hem 3 cm.
• Total width = (hip + 4 cm) × 1.5. Length 60 cm (23.5 in).
• Drafted with the help of software from a standard size chart.
• Skill level: absolute beginner.

DEUTSCH: Einfacher Gummizugrock aus zwei Rechtecken, Größen XS–3X, A4/Letter und A0, Nähanleitung auf Deutsch. Ohne Nahtzugabe.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. PDF pattern only, no physical item will be shipped.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales. Please don't share or resell the files.
